scripts.build:wasm: RUSTFLAGS='-C target-feature=+simd128' wasm-pack build crates/panoloom-wasm --target web --release --out-dir ../../packages/app/src/engine/pkg --out-name panoloom
scripts.build:wasm-mt: RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=nightly RUSTFLAGS='-C target-feature=+simd128,+atomics,+bulk-memory,+mutable-globals -C link-arg=--shared-memory -C link-arg=--import-memory -C link-arg=--max-memory=4294967296 -C link-arg=--export=__wasm_init_tls -C link-arg=--export=__tls_size -C link-arg=--export=__tls_align -C link-arg=--export=__tls_base' wasm-pack build crates/panoloom-wasm --target web --release --out-dir ../../packages/app/src/engine/pkg-mt --out-name panoloom -- --features mt -Z build-std=panic_abort,std
scripts.dev: pnpm build:wasm && pnpm build:wasm-mt && pnpm --filter @panoloom/app dev
scripts.build: pnpm build:wasm && pnpm build:wasm-mt && pnpm -r build
